Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Initial commit: ColorTap MVP online coloring platform

Features:
- Homepage with category grid and random image selection
- Category pages with image thumbnails
- Interactive coloring page with tap-to-fill functionality
- 12 basic colors with real-time pencil indicator
- Advanced options: gradients and patterns (stripes, dots, checkerboard, hearts, stars)
- Download colored images as PNG
- Fully responsive design (mobile-first)
- 4:3 aspect ratio canvas with clickable white background
- Clear button with confirmation dialog
- Next Image button for random image selection

Tech Stack:
- Vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks)
- SVG-based coloring images
- CSS3 with flexbox/grid layout
- Live-server for development

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Id, Path })
PowerShell(python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); [print\(m['name']\) for m in d.get\('models',[]\)]" 2>&1)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/tags" -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; $d = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $d.models | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.name\)  \($\([math]::Round\($_.size/1GB,1\)\) GB\)" } } catch { "Error: $_" })

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path "scripts/tools/fun-facts.json"\) { $d = Get-Content "scripts/tools/fun-facts.json" | ConvertFrom-Json; $d.PSObject.Properties.Count } else { "fun-facts.json not yet created" })

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path "scripts/tools/fun-facts.json"\) { $d = Get-Content "scripts/tools/fun-facts.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $count = $d.PSObject.Properties.Count; "Generated: $count / 85"; $d.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { $wc = \($_.Value -split '\\s+'\).Count; "$\($_.Name\): $wc words" } } else { "No fun-facts.json yet" })

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path "scripts/tools/fun-facts.json"\) { $d = Get-Content "scripts/tools/fun-facts.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $count = $d.PSObject.Properties.Count; "Generated: $count / 85" } else { "Not started yet" })
PowerShell(Test-Path "$env:TEMP\\fun-facts-gen.log"; Get-Item "$env:TEMP\\fun-facts-gen.log" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Length, LastWriteTime)

PowerShell($body = '{"model":"qwen3:4b","prompt":"Write one sentence about elephants.","stream":false,"options":{"num_predict":100,"think":false}}'; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/generate" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -TimeoutSec 120 -UseBasicParsing; $d = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "Response: $\($d.response\)"; "Tokens: eval=$\($d.eval_count\) prompt=$\($d.prompt_eval_count\)")

PowerShell($body = '{"model":"qwen3:4b","prompt":"Write one sentence about elephants.","stream":false,"options":{"num_predict":100,"think":false}}'; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/generate" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -TimeoutSec 120 -UseBasicParsing; $r.Content | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\(repr\(d.get\('response',''\)\)\)")

PowerShell($body = '{"model":"qwen3:4b","prompt":"Write one sentence about elephants.","stream":false,"options":{"num_predict":100,"think":false}}'; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/generate" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -TimeoutSec 120 -UseBasicParsing; $r.RawContent | Select-Object -First 5)

PowerShell($start = Get-Date; $body = '{"model":"gemma4:e2b","prompt":"Write two sentences about elephants.","stream":false,"options":{"num_predict":60}}'; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/generate" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -TimeoutSec 120 -UseBasicParsing; $d = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $elapsed = [math]::Round\(\(\(Get-Date\) - $start\).TotalSeconds, 1\); "Time: ${elapsed}s | Tokens: eval=$\($d.eval_count\)"; $d.response)

PowerShell($body = '{"model":"gemma4:e2b","prompt":"Write two sentences about elephants.","stream":false,"options":{"num_predict":60}}'; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/generate" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -TimeoutSec 120 -UseBasicParsing; $r.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(800, $r.Content.Length\)\))
